title: Unpointed finite Galois torsors descend along affine inverse limits
statement: Let I be a small cofiltered category, D:I→Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transition morphisms, and κ:X→D a limiting cone. For every finite group G and finite étale G-torsor Z→X (not necessarily connected), there are an object i, a finite étale G-torsor Z₀→Dᵢ, and a map χ:Z.P→Z₀.P making the square with the projections and κᵢ cartesian. The torsor notion is [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]; qcqs and affine-transition conventions are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; the square is as in [def-pc-fibre-product].

proof.text: Reindex I by the opposite of a nonempty directed partial order A using IsFiltered.exists_directed on Iᵒᵖ and F.leftOp.Initial. Functor.Initial.isLimitWhiskerEquiv transfers the given limiting cone. The inherited qcqs and affine-transition assumptions are local instances. A stage of the restriction is an object of I.

The private helper exists_finiteEtaleSurjective_limit_stage applies Scheme.exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation to Z.π. The model is qcqs by quasi-compact and quasi-separated permanence. Its pullback is finite, étale, and surjective by the cartesian model isomorphism. Apply exists_isFinite_baseChange_stage, Etale.exists_stage_of_inverseLimit, and exists_surjective_of_isLimit separately. Choose a common upper bound and use base-change stability to retain all three properties. Pullback pasting gives a finite étale surjective model with its cartesian comparison.

The private helper exists_action_maps_stage conjugates each Z.smul g through the cartesian model isomorphism and descends it by Scheme.exists_pullback_hom_of_isLimit (01ZM(2)). Finiteness of G gives a common upper bound of the factorization stages. Pullback lifts construct actual endomorphisms on that common model; checking their two projections proves base compatibility and equivariance with Z.

The private helper exists_action_laws_stage uses equivariance to show that the unit equation and all multiplication equations hold after base change to the limit. Apply Scheme.exists_pullback_fst_comp_eq_of_isLimit (01ZM(3)) to each equation. Finiteness of G × G gives a common stage. Pullback hom_ext and transport of the projected equalities prove the action laws for the canonically base-changed endomorphisms.

Descend invertibility of the torsor comparison. The comparison_pullback_data and comparison_isIso_iff helpers prove universality of its finite coproduct and fibre-square base changes: finite coproduct universality is Mathlib FinitaryPreExtensive.isUniversal_finiteCoproducts, the fibre-square square is proved by the pullback universal property, and equivariance proves the comparison square on coproduct components and both projections. The finite coproduct is qcqs by finite_coproduct_lfp_qcqs; the fibre square is qcqs by finite morphism permanence. The comparison is étale by postcomposition cancellation and hence locally finitely presented. The exists_iso_snd and exists_iso_overPullback helpers compare an isomorphism model with the identity model using exists_iso_of_isPullback (01ZM(2),(3)), as in the proved private helpers of DescendMonomorphism. This gives a later stage at which the base-changed comparison is invertible. The base-change comparison equivalence identifies it with the required canonical comparison.

Base-change the genuine action once more to the stage where its comparison is invertible. Check the unit, multiplication, and base-compatibility laws on the two pullback projections. Assemble the GaloisCover using the finite, étale, and surjective base-change instances and the comparison isomorphism. isPullback_isPullbackLift gives the final cartesian square; the restricted diagram stage is sent back by F.leftOp to an object of I.

proof_origin.note: Plan implemented in Lean, including finite action maps, action equations, comparison base change, and isomorphism descent. Local proof bookkeeping reuses the proved private arguments of GenericOpenFiniteEtaleModel, GaloisCoverBaseChange, and DescendMonomorphism. No new postponed theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem GaloisCover.exists_stage_of_affine_limits
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (hDqc : ∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)) (hDqs : ∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i))
    (hDa : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (κ : (Functor.const I).obj X ⟶ D)
    (hκ : IsLimit (Cone.mk X κ))
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (Z : GaloisCover G X) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Z₀ : GaloisCover G (D.obj i)) (χ : Z.P ⟶ Z₀.P),
      IsPullback χ Z.π Z₀.π (κ.app i)
